description: This file defines the DevServer class for Next.js, handling development server setup, routing, file watching, and hot reloading.

classes.name: DevServer
classes.description: A development server class for Next.js, extending the base Server class, managing routing, hot reloading, file watching, and error handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the DevServer with configuration options, sets up file watchers and static path worker.

methods.name: readBuildId
methods.description: Returns the build ID, here always 'development' in dev mode.

methods.name: addExportPathMapRoutes
methods.description: Adds custom routes based on exportPathMap for development.

methods.name: startWatcher
methods.description: Starts watching the pages directory for changes to trigger hot reloads.

methods.name: stopWatcher
methods.description: Stops the file watcher.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the server by verifying TypeScript setup, loading routes, initializing hot reloader, and starting watchers.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes watchers and stops the hot reloader.

methods.name: hasPage
methods.description: Checks if a page exists for a given path.

methods.name: _beforeCatchAllRender
methods.description: Handles public file conflicts and serves public files if applicable.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main request handler that manages dev-specific routing and delegates to the base server run method.

methods.name: getCustomRoutes
methods.description: Returns default custom routes, overridden during prepare.

methods.name: getPreviewProps
methods.description: Generates preview mode cookies for API routes.

methods.name: generateRoutes
methods.description: Generates development-specific route handlers, including special Next.js routes.

methods.name: _filterAmpDevelopmentScript
methods.description: Filters out disallowed AMP development scripts from HTML.

methods.name: getStaticPaths
methods.description: Lazy loads static paths for a given page in dev mode.

methods.name: ensureApiPage
methods.description: Ensures an API page is loaded via hot reloader.

methods.name: renderToHTML
methods.description: Renders a page to HTML, ensuring compilation and handling errors.

methods.name: renderErrorToHTML
methods.description: Renders an error page to HTML, ensuring fallback pages are loaded.

methods.name: sendHTML
methods.description: Sends HTML response with no-cache headers in dev.

methods.name: setImmutableAssetCacheControl
methods.description: Sets cache control headers for assets.

methods.name: servePublic
methods.description: Serves static public files.

methods.name: hasPublicFile
methods.description: Checks if a public file exists.

methods.name: getCompilationError
methods.description: Retrieves compilation errors for a page.

methods.name: isServeableUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is safe and serveable.
